description:
This model is based on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-lossless-CSF by Local Inference Lab, Inc., a non-profit organization, available at https://huggingface.co/local-inference-lab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-lossless-CSF. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-lossless-CSF is licensed under the Local Inference Lab License, Version 1.0.

jcartu’s CSF derivative of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 applies norm-preserving abliteration to 132 dense tensors. It accepts text, supports tool calling and structured JSON output, and offers none, low, high and max reasoning effort. Input and output share a 1,048,576-token context window, with up to 943,718 output tokens. This offering uses jcartu/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-abliterated-lossless-CSF.
name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated CSF (jcartu)
